usages.explain: Used to prohibit the listener's behavior. Often spoken with a lowering tone at the end of the sentence. It is spoken language, often used by men. Women often use the polite form "んじゃありません".

examples.content: 教室で携帯を使うんじゃない。
examples.transcription: きょうしつでけいたいをつかうんじゃない。
examples.mean: Don't use your cell phone in the classroom.

examples.content: 博物館で展示品を触るんじゃない。
examples.transcription: はくぶつかんでてんじひんをさわるんじゃない。
examples.mean: Don't touch the exhibits at the museum.

title: んじゃない => can not, impossible to...
